title.narrative: To reduce the tuberculosis epidemic and burden by 50% in incidence rate and 75% in deaths by 2025 (from 2015 baseline) - Tanzania (United Republic) (01-Jan-2021-31-Dec-2023)

description.narrative: Tanzania (United Republic), Tuberculosis, Ministry of Finance of the United Republic of Tanzania (MoF)This program has the following goals: To reduce the tuberculosis epidemic and burden by 50% in incidence rate and 75% in deaths by 2025 (from 2015 baseline). The objectives of this program are: To increase TB treatment coverage from 53% in 2018 to 90% in 2025 by innovatively addressing barriers to access, utilization and the needs of the key and vulnerable populations for TB care and prevention services.. To expand access of quality TB diagnostic services including adoption of new diagnostic technologies by 2025.. To maintain proportion of childhood TB among the notified cases at 15%, increasing the ratio of '0-4':5-14 to 1.5 by 2025. To increase RR/MDR-TB cases detected and enrolled for treatment from 54% to 90% of the estimated cases among notified cases by 2025.. To Strengthen management of co-morbidities including Collaborative TB/HIV activities, and Prevention of TB for persons at high risks. To strengthen TB services to population of miners and the mining areas by 2025
